facts.business: DEE Development Engineers Limited is one of India's largest process piping players by installed capacity, providing engineering, procurement, manufacturing and supply of piping systems for power, oil & gas, petrochemicals & chemicals, data centres and emerging energy sectors.

capacity_or_capex.item: India's first seamless pipe plant of its kind commissioned

auditor.name: S.R. Batliboi & Co. LLP
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Emphasis of Matter on uncertainty relating to appeal filed by Punjab State Power Corporation Limited (PSPCL) before APTEL and Civil Writ Petition filed by the Company before Hon'ble High Court of Punjab and Haryana regarding retrospective downward revision of tariff by PSPCL effective January 1, 2024. No adjustments made as matters are sub-judice. Opinion not modified.

Tariff dispute with Punjab State Power Corporation Limited (PSPCL) - retrospective downward revision effective January 1, 2024, matters sub-judice
